Version 1
SubGoalCombiner SGC_AND
INITSECTION
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedHeart_Init();

KBSECTION
// Shared Heart (the Resonant capstone, spec 7.6). GENERATED by gen_emotion_alchemy.pl -- do not edit by hand.
//REGION Tables (DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SurgeRoot lives in ARCANA_Aspect_Temperance)
PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedHeart_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult(_S)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult(_S);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedHeart_Init()
THEN
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult("FEELING_AGGRESSIVENESS");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult("FEELING_PRIDE");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult("FEELING_OPTIMISM");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult("FEELING_MORBIDNESS");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult("FEELING_DELIGHT");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult("FEELING_LOVE");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult("FEELING_DOMINANCE");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult("FEELING_HOPE");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult("FEELING_SENTIMENTALITY");
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult("FEELING_CURIOSITY");

IF
SavegameLoaded()
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedHeart_Init();
//END_REGION

//REGION A Surge result on a linked creature reaches every other linked creature (source = that target: counted once, R19)
IF
StatusApplied((CHARACTER)_Target, _Status, (CHARACTER)_Resonant, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedResult(_Status)
AND
HasPassive(_Resonant, "Arcana_Passive_EmotionalAlchemy", 1)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Target, "SHARED_HEART", 1)
AND
GetStatusTurns(_Target, _Status, _Turns)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Aspect_InCombat(_Target, _Combat)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedCopy(_Target, _Status, _Turns, _Combat);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedCopy((CHARACTER)_Target, (STRING)_Status, (INTEGER)_Turns, (GUIDSTRING)_Combat)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Aspect_InCombat(_Other, _Combat)
AND
_Other != _Target
AND
IsDead(_Other, 0)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Other, "SHARED_HEART", 1)
AND
IntegerProduct(_Turns, 6, _Secs)
AND
IntegerToReal(_Secs, _Dur)
THEN
ApplyStatus(_Other, _Status, _Dur, 1, _Target);
//END_REGION

//REGION R44: a Catharsis on a linked creature heals every other linked creature
IF
StatusApplied((CHARACTER)_Target, "CATHARSIS", (CHARACTER)_Resonant, _)
AND
HasPassive(_Resonant, "Arcana_Passive_EmotionalAlchemy", 1)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Target, "SHARED_HEART", 1)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Aspect_InCombat(_Target, _Combat)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedCatharsis(_Target, _Combat);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_SharedCatharsis((CHARACTER)_Target, (GUIDSTRING)_Combat)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Aspect_InCombat(_Other, _Combat)
AND
_Other != _Target
AND
IsDead(_Other, 0)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Other, "SHARED_HEART", 1)
THEN
ApplyStatus(_Other, "RESONANT_SHARED_CATHARSIS", 0.0, 1, _Target);
//END_REGION

EXITSECTION

ENDEXITSECTION
